query:
SELECT
                f.short_code,
                f.kind,
                f.status,
                f.body,
                f.accepted_at,
                (SELECT count(*) FROM feedback_board_votes v WHERE v.feedback_id = f.id) AS "vote_count!"
            FROM feedback AS f
            WHERE f.tenant_id = $1 AND f.project_id = $2
              AND f.moderation_status = 'approved'
            ORDER BY f.accepted_at DESC
            LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
